profile.rationale: JopeDime is a Rust GP/ML and fitted-export repository. The auditor assumes a Rust/React/PostgreSQL application and canonical ops/ and python-ai/ folders. Keep existing supported languages and deployed paths; redesigning them during a release freeze requires a separate migration and qualification. This does not establish conformance to that reference stack.
profile.closure_route: Verify actual boundaries and qualify a versioned repository-specific audit profile; do not lower the present score floor.

shape.rationale: The scorer reports large authored modules. Their size is maintenance debt; a split is not a safe name-only fix because visibility and qualification surfaces can change. Retain the finding and plan subsystem-specific refactors after the release freeze.
shape.closure_route: Split one subsystem at a time with preserved tests and behavior.

marker.decision: Retain lexical warnings with their exact locations
marker.rationale: A flagged word is not enough to prove unfinished behavior. Work-list variables named todo, stale-input refusals, temporary-file descriptions and historical identity names are valid uses. Each location is retained; unresolved behavioral TODOs need owner review rather than a bulk rename that improves the score without fixing behavior.
marker.closure_route: Inspect the bound source location before changing behavior; preserve pinned source and historical records.

unsupported.rationale: genome.rs rejects the unsupported caruana blend rather than executing an incomplete implementation. The regression release does not claim this operator. Removing the refusal would weaken the input boundary.
unsupported.closure_route: Implement and qualify the operator under a separate supported-version contract if it is needed.

fallback.rationale: The benchmark adapter catches an exception to produce a failure result. An exception-handler marker alone does not establish successful fallback computation. Full failure-accounting and permitted-input qualification remain required; this release note is not proof of those operational gates.
fallback.closure_route: Replay adapter failures and verify their terminal accounting before expanding its qualified scope.

unsafe.rationale: The audit lacks a nearby local safety argument at this source location. That is a real documentation/proof gap, not proof that the code is sound or unsound. A complete lifetime, bounds, alignment, ownership and synchronization review is larger than a cheap release fix. Preserve this unresolved risk; passing CPU tests or adding a comment alone will not close it.
unsafe.closure_route: Review the exact operation and its callers; add a correct safety argument and adversarial receiving-path tests. No blanket unsafe allowance.

unsafe-string.decision: Reject an unsafe-code detector false positive
unsafe-string.rationale: The match is the word unsafe followed by an interpolated field inside a refusal message, not a Rust unsafe expression. The receiving code rejects unsafe path components. Keep the refusal and document this lexical mismatch.
unsafe-string.closure_route: Use syntax-aware detection; preserve path-refusal tests.

zero-mask.rationale: core.rs initializes libc::cpu_set_t, an integer bit-mask structure, to zero and bounds CPU indices before access. The source has a local SAFETY argument. This specific type does not fabricate a Rust reference or invalid enum; do not generalize that reasoning to arbitrary zeroed types.
zero-mask.closure_route: Retain Linux type/bounds proof and affinity tests; re-evaluate on platform changes.

zero-signal.rationale: gp.rs zero-initializes libc::sigaction before assigning its handler/mask for a Linux syscall. This is not a general authorization for mem::zeroed. A platform-specific validity and signal-handler audit remains required.
zero-signal.closure_route: Review all fields, signal safety, process-group cleanup and qualified platform assumptions.

raw.decision: Review raw-view lifetime and bounds separately
raw.rationale: The cited call constructs a read-only slice. corpus.rs now checks mapping capacity and record bounds (#229); training.rs describes the live f32 byte view. Neither is an ownership transfer into an allocator. The detector wording is broader than the operation, but full lifetime/alignment proof remains the subsystem owner's responsibility.
raw.closure_route: Retain exact mapping bounds and byte-hash parity tests; review destruction and aliasing.

send.decision: Retain thread-safety review as a release limitation
send.rationale: An unsafe Send implementation needs proof about the library/device handle and every consumer. Nearby mutex comments are not a complete CUDA context/thread-affinity audit. Lane C owns the current GPU shape-bounds fix; ROOT does not overlap it or claim GPU safety qualification.
send.closure_route: Review handle ownership, locking and CUDA context assumptions with actual runtime qualification.

channel.rationale: The unbounded channel is a real resource/backpressure concern. Changing capacity during a release freeze can change scheduling, failure handling and deadlock behavior. Keep it visible; this release does not establish a bounded production campaign merely because a command exists.
channel.closure_route: Freeze queue limits; test blocked consumers, cancellation, exhaustion and durable failure accounting.

pickle.decision: Restrict the claim to trusted executable artifacts
pickle.rationale: pickle/joblib deserialization can execute code. A caller-supplied SHA-256 is an integrity comparison, not producer authentication or a sandbox. These paths cannot be represented as safe loaders for arbitrary input. Preserve this limitation until authenticated production provenance and isolation, or a data-only format, are qualified.
pickle.closure_route: Reject untrusted artifacts through the receiving boundary; qualify authenticated producer identity and execution isolation.

pickle-test.rationale: The match is in adapter tests using fitted artifact bytes. Test-local construction does not make the product loader safe for untrusted bytes. Keep the tests and retain the product limitation separately.
pickle-test.closure_route: Keep positive and malicious-artifact refusal tests; do not treat digest parity as authentication.

sql-fixture.rationale: The flagged test_family_pin.py call has question-mark placeholders with a separately supplied parameter tuple. It builds a negative registry fixture in a temporary local database, not SQL by concatenating untrusted data.
sql-fixture.closure_route: Preserve read-only-registry refusal tests and parameter binding.

checksum.rationale: TokenizedCorpus(..., verify=False) is a corpus checksum-loading option, not an HTTP certificate-verification switch. Parent corpus binding and process-spawn reload checks must be reviewed separately; this note does not qualify all cached loading paths.
checksum.closure_route: Verify the admitted corpus and worker reload closure; keep TLS verification enabled in network clients.

pinned-exec.rationale: v2_rowsel_build.py reads the GSK port with read_verified(GSK, GSK_SHA256) before compile/exec. It deliberately executes pinned code rather than arbitrary caller-provided source. The pin/provenance and filesystem custody remain trusted prerequisites, and this is not a general safe eval API.
pinned-exec.closure_route: Verify producer authority, exact consumed bytes and source pin before execution; qualify a typed module replacement separately.

ci-selfhost.decision: Record runner isolation as a separate gate
ci-selfhost.rationale: A self-hosted label is not evidence of a Docker socket mount. fast-lane.sh explicitly says the CI image has no Docker socket; workflow permissions are read-only and checkout credentials are not persisted. Actual launcher isolation and hostile-PR qualification remain runner-owner gates. ROOT will not change ENG:JAILGUN runner controls.
ci-selfhost.closure_route: Inspect the current launch boundary and retain independent hostile-job isolation evidence.

ci-concurrency.rationale: These workflows have no workflow-level concurrency group. Cancelling main evidence or release work can destroy required coverage, so copying the PR cancel-in-progress policy is not a safe cheap fix. The dispatch-only release workflow is not the host release procedure.
ci-concurrency.closure_route: Design per-workflow serialization/cancellation with exact-head evidence retention; qualify under existing reservations.

ci-metadata.rationale: The cited expressions record builder_image/max_glibc or pass AWS_REGION. Those are runtime/build metadata, not credential file paths. This finding does not verify that every workflow artifact is credential-free; separate secret and runner guards still apply.
ci-metadata.closure_route: Keep credential bytes out of artifacts and independently qualify publication boundaries.

git-help.rationale: release.sh prints tag-delete guidance for a locally created unpublished tag, or only after checking it is absent remotely. These cited lines are heredoc help text, not an executed destructive command. Remote state still must be checked by the operator.
git-help.closure_route: Retain fail-closed tag/publication tests and immutable published-tag policy.

git-fixture.rationale: test-release.sh stages a complete constructed fixture and mutates a tag in its local bare test remote. This does not authorize staging an agent checkout wholesale or changing a public release tag.
git-fixture.closure_route: Keep test-root confinement and real-publish refusal tests.

rot-version.decision: Preserve versioned contracts and qualified reference binaries
rot-version.rationale: The path contains an explicit algorithm/schema/release version. Renaming it merely to silence a pattern would break source pins, replay commands or persisted identities. Keep it until a reviewed migration retires its consumers.
rot-version.closure_route: Inventory consumers and preserve source/evidence before a version migration.

rot-doc.rationale: binary_cv.rs contains prose explaining the schema-bound public fit path and class-stratified folds. The flagged comment is not executable parked code. Classification remains outside the initial regression remediation scope.
rot-doc.closure_route: Retain the explanatory contract; qualify classification separately.

rot-disabled.decision: Remove the hard-disabled duplicate CV loop
rot-disabled.rationale: final_cv contains an if false block and an unreachable-code allowance after the active pooled/nonpooled evaluators. Removing only that unreachable block preserves the active scores and fit allowance while eliminating misleading parked implementation.
rot-disabled.closure_route: Focused HLT-040 PR; existing 14 strategy-screen tests, formatting and detector replay. Exact-head CI/review still required.

copy.rationale: The detector finds repeated grammar/GP units, pinned Lambda snapshots and empty Python package markers. Consolidation requires dependency/version and behavior review; empty package initializers are not duplicate algorithm implementations. Do not remove pinned snapshots or merge semantic variants solely to raise the score.
copy.closure_route: Classify each duplicated unit, prove semantic equivalence, then update source pins and differential tests together.

enum.rationale: Same short enum names across crate/module namespaces do not establish interchangeable meanings. A shared enum migration needs field/variant and persisted-schema proof. Width alone or spelling alone is not identity.
enum.closure_route: Review each cited pair; consolidate only semantically identical contracts with compatibility tests.

badge.decision: Route live CI badge to the release owner
badge.rationale: The README lacks a health badge. Lane B owns the release README badge/version/GP changes. Record this pending presentation fix; do not publish a green audit badge for a score of 47 or treat a badge as current execution evidence.
badge.closure_route: Release PR adds a CI link/badge, retains source/head-scoped evidence and all failures.

ci-layout.rationale: The reference profile requires ops/ci and scripts/ci-* paths. This repository uses deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh, deploy/ci/check.sh, .githooks and just required; workflow jobs wrap those commands in receipts. Keep the path mismatch visible without claiming the local required gate covers every hosted lane.
ci-layout.closure_route: Verify actual local/hosted command parity and per-lane receipts; no directory-name-only rewrite.

ci-audit.decision: Record out-of-band audit without a passing gate claim
ci-audit.rationale: There is no Jankurai CI gate and the retained full audit fails 85. The owner explicitly permits a fully documented triage for the release criterion. Do not add an always-green wrapper, score exclusion or lower threshold to manufacture conformance.
ci-audit.closure_route: Qualify a reproducible audit lane/profile separately; preserve every hard finding and the failing score.

security-lane.decision: Separate actual security checks from reference names
security-lane.rationale: deploy/ci/fast-lane.sh invokes cargo-deny, and deploy/ci/check.sh invokes the secret-scan wrapper and the private-key-text guard. The detector expects different workflow names. These source hooks do not establish current execution, complete supply-chain coverage or hardened runner isolation.
security-lane.closure_route: Read exact-head security receipts and maintain pinned dependency/secret checks; retain uncovered scope.

secret-pattern.decision: Redact a scanner-policy token without claiming secret-free history
secret-pattern.rationale: The matched line is the gitleaks allowlist paths field containing a synthetic fixture/private-key-armor pattern, not a verified live credential. Default gitleaks rules remain enabled. The broad exception policy still needs independent review. Raw secret-like evidence is not copied into this public register.
secret-pattern.closure_route: Review each allowlist scope and run history/tree scans; rotate only independently confirmed live credentials.

fixture-freeze.rationale: The match is inside a historical content-addressed emitted-source fixture, not a changed current test assertion. Rewriting it would destroy the baseline. Current replay tests and approved transition records are required separately; the fixture alone is not proof.
fixture-freeze.closure_route: Retain exact historical bytes and require maintained current replay/parity tests.

io-comment.decision: Reject a file-reader comment as a review attestation
io-comment.rationale: io.rs describes accepting plain/gzip/zstd inputs and fixture compression. It does not certify independent human review or a numerical result. Keep the actual PR review and verification records separate.
io-comment.closure_route: Retain decompression fixtures; bind any future review claim to a named review and full source SHA.

sql-product.decision: Preserve parameterized SQL in the ledger
sql-product.rationale: The cited statement uses task=?, dataset_hash=?, semantic_sha256=? and protocol_sha256=? placeholders with bound parameters. Adjacent transactional recheck and insertion stay intact. The token match does not establish an unvalidated input sink.
sql-product.closure_route: Retain race/idempotency and malicious-value tests without string interpolation.

nats.decision: Reject logarithmic-unit text as a streaming client
nats.rationale: decode_outcomes.rs:8 uses nats for logit spacing in a fixed-logit sampler fixture. It does not instantiate a NATS client or expose an unbounded streaming adapter.
nats.closure_route: Retain sampler refusal/exhaustion fixtures; improve syntax/context-aware detection.

release-layout.rationale: The expected docs/release.md does not exist; docs/release/README.md contains the host release procedure and its limitations. Do not confuse documented source procedure with a completed dry run, signed package or tag.
release-layout.closure_route: Retain the runbook and qualify actual release evidence before publishing.

cost.decision: Keep campaign budgets and CI cost proof separate
cost.rationale: docs/testing.md documents test families; compute studies have separate immutable admissions and deadlines. A documentation score does not prove spend control. No training/GPU/storage grant or renewed budget is inferred by this audit.
cost.closure_route: Bind each executed campaign to its original resource ceiling, deadline and complete attempt accounting.

observability.rationale: The dimension score is below 85. CI receipt/result machinery and testing docs exist, but the score is not an operational recovery or complete logging proof. Missing runtime evidence remains open.
observability.closure_route: Qualify failure injection and reconstruction using source-bound execution receipts.

context.rationale: AGENTS.md and ownership records exist, but navigation/context dimensions are below the reference floor. No source file or ownership map by itself closes the operational contracts.
context.closure_route: Keep synchronized claims and tighten subsystem navigation with owner-reviewed documentation.

boundary.rationale: The reference data/contract dimension is below 85. Actual schema, fit-authority and provenance controls must be evaluated at their receiving paths. This triage does not establish all W1-W12 gates, live training, S3 restoration or serving qualification.
boundary.closure_route: Continue receiving-boundary, ancestry, forbidden-input and independent replay qualification; report each evidence scope separately.
